title: Leg falls asleep? That's paresthesia!
caption:
Ever stood up and felt electric ants on your leg?
A cartoon gamer leaps up to stretch after a marathon session, and his leg erupts into a swarm of tingling electric ants before he limps away in peg-leg mode.
That's paresthesia: sitting compressed the nerves, and as blood flow returns (re-perfusion) they fire false alerts - the classic pins-and-needles surge.
What's the longest you've sat before your leg fell asleep?
Share this with your gamer friend and follow for daily body science.
